notes.note: Reviewed for fix round 1 (inputs: docs/architecture/module-map.md). Fix round 1 is confined to desktop startup recovery: Restart on a non-owned home re-runs the native recovery commit; deadline/Restart/Quit/dialog routing moved behind a testable StartupRecoveryHost; the non-macOS dialog adds Keep Waiting and dismissal no longer quits; the macOS cover key monitor evicts the hidden WebView from first responder, routes Tab/Space/Return and allowlists app/window Command shortcuts; a failed overdue cover falls back to the dialog; window destruction clears cover state; and a rendererLiveness comment now names the Restart/Quit surface. Searched this document for startup-readiness, cover, dialog, deadline, keyboard and renderer-liveness claims affected by these inputs and found none; its cited claims remain accurate. No prose change.
